title: Bạn có thể giúp tôi đặt một chiếc taxi được không?
englishTitle: Can you help me book a taxi?
pronunciation: Ban co the giup toi dat mot chiec taxi duoc khong
summary: For asking airport staff or a counter helper to help book a taxi when the ride setup is not simple.

sections.title: At a glance
sections.body: The hotel address, pickup app, baggage, or arrival crowd makes booking awkward.

sections.title: Quick say
sections.body: Show the hotel address or booking screen while you ask. That keeps the ride request practical.

phrases.vietnamese: Bạn có thể giúp tôi đặt một chiếc taxi được không?
phrases.english: Can you help me book a taxi?
phrases.pronunciation: Ban co the giup toi dat mot chiec taxi duoc khong

sections.title: Break it down
sections.body: Bạn có thể asks can you; giúp tôi đặt means help me book; một chiếc taxi means a taxi; được không asks if possible.

breakdown.vietnamese: Bạn có thể giúp tôi đặt một chiếc taxi được không?
breakdown.english: Can you help me book a taxi?

sections.title: Useful nearby phrases
sections.body: Taxi counter, official taxi line, and Grab pickup phrases help if the answer points you somewhere else.

phrases.vietnamese: Đây có phải là tuyến taxi chính thức?
phrases.english: Is this the official taxi line?
phrases.pronunciation: Day co phai la tuyen taxi chinh thuc

phrases.english: Where is the Grab pickup point?

sections.title: When to use it
sections.body: Good at airport counters, hotel-transfer desks, baggage areas, and pickup zones after arrival.

sections.title: Good to know
sections.body: Confirm the destination and payment before leaving the counter. The right ride matters more than the fastest one.

sections.title: Explore next
sections.body: Pickup area, meet driver, cannot-find-driver, driver-card-payment, and hotel-address phrases cover the ride handoff.
